'''''Cnidium''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the family [[Apiaceae]], native to [[Eurasia]] and [[North America]].<ref name="POWO_30087062-2">{{citation |title=''Cnidium'' Cusson ex Juss. |work=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:30087062-2 |access-date=2022-12-10 }}</ref>

==Species==

*''[[Cnidium cnidiifolium]]'' <small>(Turcz.) Schischk.</small>
*''[[Cnidium dauricum]]'' <small>(Jacq.) Fisch. & C.A.Mey.</small>
*''[[Cnidium divaricatum]]'' <small>(Jacq.) Ledeb.</small>
*''[[Cnidium japonicum]]'' <small>Miq.</small>
*''[[Cnidium monnieri]]'' <small>(L.) Cusson</small>
*''[[Cnidium silaifolium]]'' <small>(Jacq.) Simonk.</small>
*''[[Cnidium warburgii]]'' <small>H.Wolff</small>
